parsed.summary: The PR fixes the issue with incorrect allow_migrate() calls in makemigrations, but introduces a new file for release notes that may not be appropriate for this change.

issues.description: The PR introduces a new file for release notes (docs/releases/2.0.txt) that is not directly related to the bug fix. This may indicate scope creep or an incomplete understanding of the release process.
